note: The A2B0 mft1 tag supplies an input_channels byte of 255, which is copied into the parsed A2B state before validation.
The loop is controlled by the unvalidated input_channels value; the required safety condition is that the loop index remains within the four grid_points elements.
For i >= 4, this assignment writes past skcms_A2B.grid_points[4], corrupting following fields in the A2B object.
